description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 React Three Fiber 官方文档站，介绍如何用 React 渲染 three.js 场景。页面提供安装命令（pnpm add three @react-three/fiber）、从 Canvas 到 Mesh 与灯光的首个场景教程，以及 API、进阶与迁移指南，并链接 CodeSandbox 示例供直接打开。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by React Three Fiber (https://r3f.docs.pmnd.rs/).
Technology stack: react, three-js.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
